<div class="card-body">
'''Skywalkers''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">スカイウォーカー（空駆ける者）たち</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ルークとレイアが一緒に戦闘している場合、戦闘運命数にを２回引いて加える。２：「完全防備の壁」「行き止まり」「橋を収納せよ」のいずれかをキャンセルできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-110o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークとレイアは、保安網に探知されないように、デス・スター内の未使用区画へ逃げ込んだ。収納された橋の一端から、敵の射線を潜りつつ、綱を握りしめて向こう側へと跳んだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Skywalkers (ones who run the sky).

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: If Luke and Leia are in battle together, draw and add two battle destiny. 2: May cancel Imperial Barrier, Wrong Turn, or Retract The Bridge.

'''Lore:''' Luke and Leia fled into an unused section of the Death Star to stay off the security net. From one end of a retracted bridge they swung across on a line through enemy fire.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Option 2 names 完全防備の壁, 行き止まり and 橋を収納せよ for Imperial Barrier, Wrong Turn and Retract The Bridge.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Skywalkers]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
